user_requested_changes: Recognize a verified bank SMS using its independent directional facts and specific built-in category, then securely save a deduplicated sender-scoped local classification rule without another multi-step setup dialog after the user confirms the transaction.

When classification is uncertain, immediately open a pre-populated beginner-friendly rule form containing a suggested name, actual sender, safe phrase chips, known kind and previously verified category where available, with advanced keyword and optional account controls collapsed.
Simplify match semantics into explicit Any keyword/All keywords choices, rename misleading scanned message copy, and keep one concise save action with encrypted owner-bound storage.

Never use OTP numbers, account numbers, balance figures, cloud inference or generic POS/payment words as learned rule keys; transfer/exclusion rules never post money, and a custom rule cannot override trusted bank direction.
Add targeted source and behavior regression tests; preserve signed APK, M385 change-scope review, encrypted finance safety and all legacy records.

When a confirmed manual income or expense supplies a safe new description, append the keyword to the reusable learned rule bucket for the same financial direction, retaining per-keyword category mapping across different merchant categories; do not create another learned rule for every manual transaction.

When a confirmed bank SMS, bank transfer or exclusion supplies a safe phrase from the same authenticated sender and kind, update the existing system-learned rule instead of duplicating it; never cross sender security boundaries or copy an amount, bank identifier or OTP.

If the same phrase maps to contradictory categories, leave the existing encrypted rule unchanged and require human review. Existing explicit user-defined and auto-post authorizations remain immutable under automatic learning.
Group the automatically learned classification list under clear income, expense, transfer and exclusion sections, keeping manual user-created rules separate and their settings unchanged.

When a trusted, separately authorized SMS rule permits automatic posting, save without an invented budget only if no active named or historical budget needs user selection; otherwise keep the bank SMS encrypted for review and Android notification. Never infer, auto-create or silently assign a budget; keep account, transfer and duplicate-post guards intact.

Classify manual transfers with a senderless non-posting transfer bucket; in Android background, acknowledge only sender-scoped, confirmed nonfinancial exclusion matches, never financial, transfer or settlement messages; do not require finance writer or auto-post authority to exclude safely.

Prefill already-reviewed bank SMS into transfer mode with stable request id, amount and date; lock the form to transfer, require two explicit account choices and verified SQLCipher transfer callback. After separately confirmed manual transfer, invoke optional safe learning callback.
After first verified manual account transfer learn safe reusable senderless transfer classification, but never post transfers without explicit two-account approval.

After reviewed bank SMS transfer, open verified account-to-account form with parsed amount and stable fingerprint-based transfer ID. Require explicit source/destination; the account writer is idempotent and SMS acknowledgement follows the verified operation.

When the background worker finds a previously user-approved nonfinancial exclusion rule, safely acknowledge its native encrypted queue item without touching balances; classify transfers as needing account review and notify outside the app where permitted.
